en-US.name: FlyAI
en-US.summary: Search and book flights, hotels, attractions and travel deals in natural language via Fliggy MCP. Install the third-party @fly-ai/flyai-cli npm package separately; DesireCore does not bundle, install or operate the CLI or Fliggy/FlyAI services. An optional FLYAI_API_KEY can enhance results; terms and charges are separate.

zh-CN.name: FlyAI
zh-CN.summary: 通过自然语言搜索并预订机票、酒店、门票等出行服务，基于飞猪 MCP 实时查询与预订。需自行用 npm 安装第三方 @fly-ai/flyai-cli；DesireCore 不打包、不安装也不代运营该 CLI 或飞猪/FlyAI 服务。可选配置 FLYAI_API_KEY 以增强结果；产品条款和费用另计。

requirements.value: A separately installed FlyAI CLI (flyai-cli) from the public npm package @fly-ai/flyai-cli, which needs Node.js on the operator's machine. DesireCore does not bundle, license, install, pay for or operate the CLI or Fliggy/FlyAI services.

The CLI calls Fliggy MCP / FlyAI online services for search and booking. A trial may run without API keys; an optional FLYAI_API_KEY can enhance results. Service availability, terms and charges are separate. If the CLI or service is unavailable, stop before the external call and never fabricate a successful result.
